# govulncheck allowlist — OSV IDs the CI vuln gate tolerates.
#
# The CI job (.github/workflows/ci.yml :: vulncheck) FAILS on any *called*
# vulnerability whose ID is not listed here. New or unexpected vulnerabilities
# therefore break the build; the entries below are the known, accepted
# exceptions. One ID per line; any text after the ID is a free-form note
# (do NOT put other GO-IDs in a note — the parser greps every GO-ID on a line).
#
# Keep this list MINIMAL. Re-evaluate on every dependency bump and delete
# entries as fixes land. Tracking: ENG-415.
#
# ── Category A: no upstream fix available (govulncheck "Fixed in: N/A") ──────
# github.com/docker/docker @ v28.5.2+incompatible has no patched release: the
# fix ships only as moby/moby/v2 v2.0.0-beta.8, a module fred does not use.
# Unlike the daemon-only advisories dropped in ENG-639, these two ARE in the
# called set — though only via docker/client package init and
# client.Client.Close, not the plugin code the advisories describe. Keep them:
# the gate compares against the called set, so removing them would fail CI.
GO-2026-4887   docker/docker — no patched release (fix only in moby/moby/v2)
GO-2026-4883   docker/docker — no patched release (fix only in moby/moby/v2)
GO-2026-4610   no fix on the binding path — reachable via docker/compose v2 (Fixed in: N/A); the separate docker/cli v29.2.0 fix does not resolve the compose-reachable instance
#
# golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained/frozen ("Fixed in: N/A"); no
# release removes it. fred reaches only the openpgp/armor ASCII-encoding
# envelope via cosmos-sdk keyring ExportPrivKeyArmor/ImportPrivKey
# (internal/chain/signer_pool.go), not openpgp message/signature crypto.
GO-2026-5932   x/crypto/openpgp unmaintained — reached only via cosmos-sdk keyring armor
#
# ── Category B: fix exists upstream, but sits past a cascade boundary in the
#    docker/compose v2 toolchain (containerd and buildkit are transitively
#    pinned by docker/compose v2.40.3). Every remaining fix here needs
#    containerd v2.2.x — v2.2.4 directly, or v2.2.1 via buildkit v0.28.1 —
#    and the 2.2 line raises k8s.io v0.32.3 → v0.34.1 and
#    prometheus/client_golang v1.23.0 → v1.23.2, both DIRECT requires.
#    Deferred to a dedicated, separately-tested dependency-upgrade PR.
#    Remove these once that lands.
#
#    The 2.1 line does NOT cascade: containerd v2.1.9 pins k8s.io at exactly
#    the v0.32.3 fred already selects, and prometheus below it. That is why
#    five containerd entries and one in-toto entry left this list in ENG-639;
#    do not re-add a blanket "compose-coupled" justification without checking
#    the requirement graph of the specific version you need.
GO-2026-5378   containerd/v2 fixed in v2.2.4 (deferred — 2.2 line cascades k8s.io + prometheus)
GO-2026-4859   moby/buildkit fixed in v0.28.1 (deferred — pulls containerd v2.2.1)
GO-2026-4858   moby/buildkit fixed in v0.28.1 (deferred — pulls containerd v2.2.1)
